target_customer: Software teams that run coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
problem: Agent reasoning is discarded when a session ends, so new agents repeat work and lack organizational context.
business_model: SaaS for shared agent memory with a free start tier
product_category: Agent memory and institutional context layer

founders.name: Nikos Dritsakos
previous_startups: SalesBop (acquired for 500K dollars per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Head of Special Projects at Composio; VP of Technology at FliteHouse.

competitors.name: Mem0
competitors.what: Open source memory layer for agents
competitors.traction_then: named in 2026 roundups for coding agents

competitors.name: Supermemory
competitors.what: Memory system with MCP server for coding agents
competitors.traction_then: listed as best for coding agents in a 2026 roundup

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting sessions from several agents and apps and injecting relevant context needs solid retrieval and integrations but uses existing model APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated team context creates lock in, but memory layers are a crowded category and agent vendors add their own memory.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Coding agent vendors were adding native memory in 2026; no action against Glen found.

market_need_then: Self reported internal evals of 29 percent fewer tokens and 21 percent faster tasks; Composio is first design partner and a dozen other companies use it (launch post, unverified).

branding.domain_note: Uses tryglen.com, a try prefix domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and conversational, frames problem as agent amnesia

branding.community_and_virality: Customers quoted on the site include Composio and Corgi Insurance; no independent brand press found.

brand_strength.rationale: Short friendly name but generic (a common given name) with no independent coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Glen is a one person company in the Summer 2026 batch with early design partners and no public funding. The bet is that shared memory across agents matters, but memory is a crowded space and platform vendors may absorb the feature.
notes: Dealroom lists a 125K seed for Glen with no investors; aggregator only, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Outcome search returned only unrelated Glenmark results. Competitor sources are 2026 vendor influenced roundups. Completeness pass: the $125k seed is now recorded as a round, resting on a single database (Dealroom, no date or investors); it may be YC's standard deal.
